name: bot-meter-for-x
description: Chrome extension that shows posts/day for X accounts to flag likely bots.

scripts.test: npm run build:creator --silent && node --test test/*.test.js && vitest run
scripts.build:creator: node scripts/build-creator.mjs
scripts.build: npm run build:creator && rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist && zip -r -X dist/bot-meter-x-$(node -p "require('./manifest.json').version").zip manifest.json icons src -x "src/creator/*"
scripts.build:tools: npm run build:creator && mkdir -p dist && cd creator-tools && zip -r -X ../dist/creator-tools-x-$(node -p "require('./manifest.json').version").zip manifest.json content.css print.html print.css bookmarks.html bookmarks.css popup.html popup.css icons gen
